design_description: This jersey combines a classic Parisian football identity with architectural and cultural references, using a sophisticated navy, red and gold palette. The base is a deep midnight navy, crossed vertically by a bold central red stripe framed by thin gold lines. This creates a strong traditional football structure while the gold detailing gives the shirt a more premium character. The collar and sleeve cuffs repeat the navy-and-gold treatment for consistency. Across the centre, SARDEGNA is integrated over the stripe in a textured multicolour treatment, becoming the main sponsor/identity element without disrupting the vertical composition. The club crest sits over the heart, with Momuto branding opposite. The most distinctive element appears across the lower front: an intricate gold line-art architectural illustration of the Fontaine Saint-Michel in Paris, extending from side to side and rising naturally from the hem. It transforms the lower section into a direct tribute to the city while remaining tonal enough not to overpower the shirt. Small fleur-de-lis symbols on both sleeves reinforce the French/Parisian theme, while the gold piping running along the sides connects the architectural illustration with the upper detailing. Overall, it is an elegant Paris-inspired design that mixes recognizable navy-and-red football heritage with ornate gold architecture and French symbolism, giving Paris Sant'Efisi a strong sense of place and identity.
